en: A vintage monochrome postcard illustration of a busy European city square with tram tracks curving through the cobblestone street in the foreground. The central focus is an ornate, multi‑story Renaissance building with richly decorated façade and arcades at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather around the square. Adjacent buildings have shop signs, including one advertising a ladies' clothing shop (Damen‑Hüte). A handwritten caption at the bottom identifies the scene.
